title: OK,  but not too bright
text: OK,  but not too bright. We bought this to go under our new high- end TV. It looks fine, very minimalist, which is what we wanted. But perhaps because of the bright light emitted by the new TV, this is almost invisible. May have to buy another one. As an alarm, it would work well: lights up when you push the button.
